blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. Here we present a model that directly co-generates the video and 3D motion for any supplied rig, along with a camera that registers this motion to the scene. Prior video-motion models either handle only human skeletons, often adding billions of parameters, or triangulate 3D motion from generated 2D pose maps. We instead keep 3D motion in a separate model that supports arbitrary skeletons, and connect it to a pretrained video model through a small set of cross-attention layers. This separation lets the motion model first learn how skeletons move from motion-only data, which is easier to obtain and augment than paired video. Additionally, our model learns to locate each joint in the video frames, which lets us recover the camera and place the 3D motion in the scene. To train across many skeletons, we use a generative video editor to place animated 3D assets in scenes suited to their actions, curating the edits so their known motion remains valid. Together with human and robot video, this yields nearly 200K training pairs. Our evaluations demonstrate that our model animates diverse rigs from text more faithfully than video-first pipelines, and its motion responds to the surrounding scene. It also turns video into rig motion, rig motion into video, and enables keyframe-based control of the 3D motion. Videos and additional results are available on our project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/.
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型现在可以描绘出非常现实的动作. 然而目前还不清楚如何使用这个运动超越像素:将特定的3D资产激活,并在3D场景中重播动画. 例如,视频模型可以显示猴子跳过交叉栏,但不能将跳跃作为可重播的3D运动放入3D场景中. 在这里,我们提出一个模型, 直接生成视频和3D运动 任何供应的钻机, 以及一个相机 登记这个运动到现场。 之前的视频运动模型要么只处理人类骨架,常常增加数十亿参数,要么从生成的2D中三角化3D运动,摆出地图. 我们反而将3D运动保留在一个支持任意骨架的单独模型中,并通过一小组交叉注意力层将其连接到一个预先训练的视频模型中. 这种分离让运动模型首先了解骨架如何从只运动数据中移动,这比配对视频更容易获得和增强. 此外,我们的模型学会定位 每一个关节在视频框, 这使得我们回收相机 并放置3D运动 在现场。 为了在很多骨架上训练,我们使用基因视频编辑器将动画3D资产放置在适合其动作的场景中,对编辑进行校正,使其已知的动作依然有效. 与人和机器人视频一起,这产生了近200K的训练配对. 我们的评价表明,我们的模型比视频第一管道更忠实地从文字中激发出各种钻机,其运动响应了周围的场景. 它还将视频转化为钻机运动,将钻机运动转化为视频,并使得基于键框的控制3D运动成为可能. 视频和额外结果见我们的项目网页:https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/。

One model covers joint generation (top two rows) and either conditional direction (bottom two rows). Mesh animation: a rigged monkey clears a scene’s high-jump bar, adapting its motion to the surroundings. Keyframe control: given a first and last frame, JCA fills in the rig motion and video between them. Video-to-motion: recovering 3D motion from an input video. Motion-to-video: video following prescribed 3D motion.
blocks.zh: 图1:联赛,镜头,动作! (JCA)为任何地形学的用户提供平台生成视频和同步3D运动轨迹. 一个模型包括联合生成(上两行)和有条件方向(下两行). 网格动画:一只被操纵的猴子清空了场景的高跳杆,使其运动适应周围环境. 键框控制:给与第一个和最后一个帧,JCA填充钻机运动和它们之间的视频. 视频对动:从输入视频中恢复3D运动. 动画对视频:按照规定3D动画的视频.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video generation models capture complex real-world dynamics, making them promising world models for animation, robotics, and synthetic data generation. Yet they produce only pixels, so their motion cannot directly drive a 3D asset or robot. Imagine placing a monkey asset in front of a crossbar in a 3D scene, asking a video model to make it jump over, and replaying the resulting jump on the monkey’s rig inside that scene. Current video models deliver only the first step: a convincing video of the jump, with no 3D motion for the rig and no way to place that motion in the scene.
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型能捕捉复杂的现实世界动态,使其成为充满希望的动画,机器人,以及合成数据生成的世界模型. 然而它们只产生像素,因此它们的运动不能直接驱动3D资产或机器人. 想象一下,在3D场景的交叉栏前放置一个猴子资产,要求一个视频模型让它跳过,并在场景内重新播放猴钻机的跳动结果. 目前的视频模型只提供第一步:一个令人信服的跳跃视频,没有3D运动的钻机,也没有任何方法将这一运动放入现场.

blocks.en: Replaying a generated motion on an arbitrary rig in a 3D scene requires two things: 3D motion that matches the video and a camera transformation that registers that motion to the generated scene. One natural approach is to recover the motion from a generated video post hoc ( Sabathier et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2025 ) , but lifting motion from pixels may introduce errors that can make the animation drift from the video. Alternatively, generating video and motion together aims to avoid this post-hoc step, yet no joint model animates an arbitrary rig directly in 3D, and none registers its motion to the scene it generates. Existing ones either handle only human skeletons ( Pang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) , or triangulate 3D motion from 2D pose maps learned from multi-view videos ( Huang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在3D场景中重放任意钻机上产生的运动需要两件事:匹配视频的3D运动和将运动记录到生成的场景的相机转换. 一个自然的方法是从生成的视频后临时恢复运动(Sabathier等人,2026年;Song等人,2025年),但像素的提升运动可能会引入错误,使动画从视频中漂移. 或者,同时生成视频和运动是为了避免这个后热步骤,然而没有一种联合模型直接在3D中为任意钻机动画,也没有一种模型在它产生的场景中记录其运动。 现存的或只处理人类骨架(Pang等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年a),或将2D的3D运动三角化,摆出从多景视频中吸取的地图(Huang等人,2025年).

blocks.en: In this work, we present Joints, Camera, Action! ( JCA ), a model that co-generates a video, motion for any supplied 3D rig, and a camera that places the 3D motion in the generated scene. To support arbitrary rigs, a dedicated motion model treats a rig skeleton as a graph, with joints as nodes and bones as edges. We pretrain it on motion alone, including motions retargeted to randomized skeletons. We then connect it to a pretrained video model through a few cross-attention layers, keeping the added parameters small. Zero-initializing these layers preserves the behavior of both pretrained models at the start of coupled training.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们呈现联合,摄像头,行动! (JCA),一种能共同生成视频的模型,任何提供的3D钻机的动作,以及将3D运动放置在生成的场景的相机. 为了支持任意钻机,专用的运动模型将钻机骨架作为图表,关节作为节点,骨骼作为边缘. 我们只训练它运动, 包括重新瞄准随机化骨架的运动。 然后我们通过几个交叉观察层将其连接到一个预先训练的视频模型中,使添加的参数保持小. 零初始化这些层保留了两个预训模型在组合训练开始时的行为.

blocks.en: Through these layers, video and motion shape each other’s generation throughout denoising; two components strengthen this interaction and place the motion in the scene. First, we introduce a novel bridge guidance mechanism. At inference, we contrast predictions made with the connections enabled and disabled, then amplify the change caused by their interaction. Co-generating the motion with the video, however, does not determine where that motion lies in the depicted scene. Second, to solve this registration problem, we introduce learned localization of the rig’s joints: the model predicts where every generated 3D joint appears in the image. These 2D locations and the generated 3D positions provide correspondences from which we fit a camera that registers the motion to the generated scene.
blocks.zh: 通过这些层层,视频和运动会在整个发音过程中塑造彼此的一代;两个组件会加强这种相互作用,并将运动置于现场. 首先,我们引入新的桥梁指导机制。 推论,我们把预测与已启用和已禁用的连接相比较,然后扩大它们相互作用引起的变化。 然而,与视频共同生成该运动并不能确定该运动在所描绘的场景中的位置. 第二,为了解决这个注册问题,我们引入了钻机关节的学习本地化:模型预测每个生成的3D关节在图像中出现的地方. 这些二维位置和生成的三维位置提供通信,我们从中安装一个相机,将运动记录到生成的场景.

blocks.en: Training the model poses a challenge: no corpus pairs natural video with 3D motion across many rigs. We start from human video, which offers rich motion and rich backgrounds, but only a single skeleton. To cover many rigs, we turn to animated 3D assets ( Deitke et al., 2023b ; Deitke et al., 2023a ) , which offer diverse rigs and precise labels, but simple actions and plain renders. Rather than build a 3D scene for every asset, a generative video editor ( Liu et al., 2026 ) places our animated-asset renders in scenes suited to their actions. Editing may move the subject or camera, invalidating 3D labels; we verify results and regenerate failures. Together, the two sources combine the rich motion and scenes of human video with the rig diversity of assets. With additional robot video, our corpus reaches 200K video–motion pairs in total.
blocks.zh: 训练该型号构成一个挑战:没有实体将天然视频与3D运动搭配在许多钻机上. 我们从人类的视频开始,它提供了丰富的运动和丰富的背景,但只有一个骨架. 为了覆盖许多钻机,我们转向动画3D资产(Deitke等人,2023年b;Deitke等人,2023年a),这些资产提供了不同的钻机和精确的标签,但简单的动作和平原。 一个基因视频编辑(Liu等人,2026年)并没有为每个资产建立3D场景,而是将我们的动画资产放在适合他们行动的场景中。 编辑可能移动主题或相机,无效3D标签;我们验证结果并再生失败. 这两个来源合在一起,结合了人类视频丰富的运动和场景,结合了资产的钻机多样性. 加上更多的机器人视频 我们的机身总共达到了200K视频 - 动画对。

blocks.en: We evaluate the model on text-driven animation of diverse rigs and demonstrate motion that responds to the surrounding scene ( fig. 1 ). The same model can recover motion for a supplied rig from video or generate video from prescribed rig motion. From a few reference image keyframes, it generates a complete 3D rig trajectory and matching video, providing image-based control over 3D motion.
blocks.zh: 我们评价各种钻机的文字驱动动画模型,并演示与周围场景相适应的运动(图. 同一型号可从录像中回收所供应的钻机的运动,或从规定的钻机运动中生成录像。 它从几个参考图像键框中生成一个完整的3D钻机轨迹和匹配视频,提供基于图像对3D运动的控制.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (1) JCA , the first model to directly co-generate video and 3D joint motion for arbitrary rigs, with motion that responds to the surrounding scene and can be controlled by image keyframes; the same model also generates either modality from the other; (2) a parameter-efficient architecture that represents arbitrary rigs as graphs, with bridge guidance amplifying video–motion agreement; (3) learned scene registration that recovers the camera needed to replay generated 3D motion in the scene; and (4) a data pipeline that places labeled asset animations in scenes suited to their actions and, together with human and robot video, yields 200K video–motion pairs spanning diverse rigs.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(1) JCA,是第一个直接联合生成视频和3D联合移动任意钻机的模型,其运动响应周围的场景,并且可以被图像键框控制;同一模型也产生另一种模式;(2) 代表任意钻机的参数效率架构,作为图表,桥面指导放大视频-运动协议;(3) 学习的场景登记,回收在现场重播生成3D运动所需的相机;(4) 数据管道,将标注的资产动画放置在适合其动作的场景中,并与人和机器人视频一起输出200K视频-运动对,横跨各种钻机.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Joint Video and Motion Generation. Video generators capture rich appearance and motion and have shown promise across diverse tasks ( Rotstein et al., 2025 ; Wiedemer et al., 2025 ; Atzmon et al., 2025 ) .
However, they output pixels rather than the underlying 3D motion.
UniMo ( Pang et al., 2025 ) , EchoMotion ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and CoMoVi ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) jointly model video and human motion; SViMo ( Dang et al., 2025 ) and VAG ( Lang et al., 2026 ) cover hand–object interactions and robot actions.
UniMo uses a shared autoregressive backbone, whereas EchoMotion and CoMoVi introduce billion-scale motion branches derived from video backbones.
EchoMotion’s joint attention assigns motion tokens spatial offsets relative to the video grid.
AnimaX ( Huang et al., 2025 ) handles arbitrary skeletons by generating RGB and 2D pose maps from four fixed views, then recovers 3D motion through triangulation and inverse kinematics. This indirect route also limits training to multi-view videos, which rich scenes rarely have.
We couple separately pretrained video and text-to-rig-motion networks through cross-attention, avoiding joint self-attention and spatial offsets.
Our model directly generates video and 3D joint parameters for a supplied rig, without mesh input or multi-view triangulation, optionally conditioned on a first image.
blocks.zh:
联合视频与动感生成. 视频发电机能捕捉丰富的外观和运动,并展现出跨越不同任务的希望(Rotstein等人,2025年;Wiedemer等人,2025年;Atzmon等人,2025年)。
然而,它们输出像素而不是基础的3D运动.
UniMo(Pang等人,2025年),回声运动 (Yang等人,2026年),和CoMoVi(Zhao等人,2026年a)联合模拟视频和人类运动;SViMo(Dang等人,2025年)和VAG(Lang等人,2026年)覆盖手-物体相互作用和机器人动作.
UniMo使用共享的自动递归主干线,而EchoMotion和CoMoVi则引入了从视频主干线衍生出来的十亿级运动分支.
EchoMotion的联合关注为运动符号分配相对于视频网格的空间抵消.
AnimaX(Huang等人,2025年)通过生成RGB和2D从四个固定视图中摆出地图来处理任意骨架,然后通过三角和反动运动来恢复3D运动. 这种间接路线也把培训限制在多景视频上,而丰富的场景很少有.
我们通过交叉注意,将预先训练的视频和文字至rig运动网络分开,避免了联合自我注意和空间抵消。
我们的模型直接生成一个供给的钻机的视频和3D联动参数,没有网格输入或多视图三角化,可选择以第一个图像为条件.

blocks.en:
Animating Diverse Skeletons and Meshes. AnyTop ( Gat et al., 2025 ) learns a shared motion prior across diverse skeletons; RigMo ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) learns rigs and motion from deforming meshes without predefined skeletons. AnimateAnyMesh ( Wu et al., 2025 ) maps mesh and text to vertex trajectories.
Video priors inform ViPS’s feed-forward pose sampling ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and per-instance animation optimization by AKD ( Li et al., 2025 ) , Puppeteer ( Song et al., 2025 ) , and skeleton-free CHORD ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) ; AKD reports about 25 hours per asset. AnimaSpark ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) avoids such optimization through video generation, tracking, and planar lifting. ActionMesh ( Sabathier et al., 2026 ) and STAC ( Samuel et al., 2026 ) output mesh deformations and Bekor et al. (2025) transfers motion across object categories without a rig by distilling video diffusion priors into dynamic Gaussians.
Our model jointly generates motion and video through coupled denoising, without tracking or fitting the motion to video.
blocks.zh:
动画 Diverse Skeletons 和 Meshes. 中国植物物种信息数据库. AnyTop(Gat等人,2025年)在跨越多种骨架之前学习过一个共享运动;RigMo(Zhang等人,2026年)在没有预先定义的骨架的情况下从变形的 meshes上学习钻机和运动. Animate Anymesh(Wu等人,2025年)将网格和文本映射到顶点轨迹.
视频前传告知了VIPS向前进的投影(Chen等人,2026年)和AKD的每集动画优化(Li等人,2025年),Puppeteer (Song等人,2025年),和无骨架的CHORD(Lyu等人,2026年);AKD报告每件资产约25小时. AnimaSpark(Zhao等人,2026b)通过视频生成,跟踪,以及平面提升来避免这种优化. ActionMesh(Sabathier等人,2026年)和STAC(Samuel等人,2026年)输出网状变形和Bekor等人. (2025)通过将视频扩散前身蒸馏成动态高斯人,在无钻机的情况下将运动跨物体类别转移.
我们的模型通过连结的调试产生运动和视频,而不跟踪或安装到视频中。

blocks.en:
Conditional Generation and Guidance. Structural and motion cues can guide visual generation:
ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) conditions image synthesis on structural input signals, Lay-A-Scene ( Rahamim et al., 2024 ) on 3D objects, MeshToken ( Liang et al., 2026 ) conditions video on 3D human mesh motion, LooseControlVideo ( Bhat et al., 2026 ) uses coarse oriented 3D boxes, and training-free Time-to-Move ( Singer et al., 2026 ) uses crude reference animations under a dual-clock denoising schedule.
Motion inpainting and constrained generation ( Tessler et al., 2024 ; Rempe et al., 2026 ) complete partial motion specifications.
EchoMotion ( Yang et al., 2026 ) supports video-to-motion and motion-to-video generation for humans.
Our training combines joint denoising with conditioning on a noise-free modality, enabling both conditional directions for arbitrary rigs through our specialized rig encoder and denoiser.
To improve generation at inference, latent optimization corrects spatial relations ( Yiflach et al., 2026 ) , VideoJAM ( Chefer et al., 2025 ) contrasts predictions with and without the jointly generated optical-flow input, and Spatiotemporal Skip Guidance ( Hyung et al., 2025 ) contrasts predictions with and without selected spatiotemporal layers.
Our bridge guidance strengthens video–motion consistency by contrasting predictions with video–motion cross-attention enabled and disabled.
blocks.zh:
有条件的生成与指导. 结构和运动提示可以引导视觉生成:
ControlNet(Zhang等人,2023年)在结构输入信号上的条件图像合成,Lay-A-Scene(Rahamim等人,2024年)在3D物体上的条件图像合成,MeshToken(Liang等人,2026年)在3D人类网状运动上的条件视频,Loose ControlVideo(Bhat等人,2026年)使用粗糙的面向3D的盒,在双点解禁时间表下使用粗糙的参考动画(Singer等人,2026年).
运动涂装和受限生成(Tessler等人,2024年;Rempe等人,2026年)完成部分运动规格.
EchoMotion(Yang et al., 2026)支持人类的视频对动和移动对视频生成.
我们的训练结合了联合调试和无噪声模式的调制,通过我们的专用钻机编码器和调制器,使任意钻机能够双向有条件地进行。
为了改进推论生成,潜在优化纠正了空间关系(Yiflach等人,2026年),VideoJAM (Chefer等人,2025年)将预测与联合产生的光流输入和没有光流输入作对比,Spatiotemporal Skipper Guide(Hyung等人,2025年)则将预测与选定的光流层和没有选定的光流层作对比。
我们的桥梁指导通过将预测与视频-运动交叉感化和禁用来增强视频-运动的一致性。

blocks.en:
Motion Recovery. While human-specific methods recover body ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2024 ) and hand motion ( Yu et al., 2025b ) from video, MoCapAnything V2 ( Gong et al., 2026 ) and TopoCap ( Pu et al., 2026 ) support arbitrary skeletons without per-instance optimization.
Our model also supports this video-to-motion task within its joint generative framework.
blocks.zh:
运动恢复。 虽然人类特有的方法从视频中恢复身体(Gao等人,2025年;Shen等人,2024年)和手动(Yu等人,2025年b年),但MoCapAnything V2(Gong等人,2026年)和TopoCap(Pu等人,2026年)支持任意骨架而不进行穿孔优化.
我们的模型还支持在其联合基因框架内的这种视频对移动任务。

blocks.en:
Training Data Pipeline. Joint video–motion methods ( Pang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) train on human videos paired with estimated motion, using a fixed skeletal representation.
VideoMDM ( Mann et al., 2026 ) avoids 3D annotation through 2D projection supervision, but also assumes a fixed skeleton.
Animated asset datasets such as AnimaX’s ( Huang et al., 2025 ) provide motion for diverse skeletons, but their renders have a white background.
Generative models have enabled the construction of training pairs for image and video editing ( Wasserman et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025a ) , and video editors can change a video’s scene while preserving its structure ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Tewel et al., 2026 ) . We use Bernini to place rendered animations of diverse rigs in suitable scenes while retaining their known 3D motion as supervision.
blocks.zh:
训练数据管道. 联合视频-运动方法(Pang等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年a) 人类视频上的训练与估计运动对齐,使用固定的骨骼代表.
视频MDM (Mann等人,2026年)通过2D投影监督避免3D注解,但也假设了固定骨架.
动画资产数据集如AnimaX’s(Huang等人,2025年)为多种骨架提供了运动,但其制作背景为白色.
基因模型为图像和视频编辑创造了培训配对(Wasserman等人,2025年;Yu等人,2025年a),视频编辑可以在保留视频结构的同时改变视频的场景(Liu等人,2026年;Tewel等人,2026年). 我们用伯尼尼将制作的 各种钻机的动画放在合适的场景中 同时保留他们已知的3D运动作为监督

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Video models have learned from countless examples of walking, crawling, and leaping, yet lack an explicit representation of the underlying rigs.
Motion models, in contrast, are built around a rig but do not directly benefit from the rich motion priors learned from video.
We bring the two together: our method generates 3D motion for an arbitrary skeleton by denoising it jointly with a video, so that each model contributes what it knows.
blocks.zh:

We describe our approach in four parts, illustrated in Fig. 2 .
Sec. 3.1 describes a motion denoiser designed and pretrained for arbitrary rigs, conditioned on per-joint descriptors from a graph-based rig encoder.
Sec. 3.2 connects it to a pretrained video generator through zero-initialized bidirectional cross-attention.
This coupling preserves separate backbones, saving billions of parameters compared with motion branches derived from the video backbone, and enables guidance that strengthens their interaction at inference.
Sec. 3.3 introduces a localization head that grounds each joint in the video, from which we fit the camera. Finally, Sec. 3.4 describes how we build training data pairing videos with 3D motion across many skeletons, by editing renders of animated assets into suited scenes.

Figure 2: Architecture overview.
Given a text prompt, a rig, and an optional reference image, the model jointly denoises video latents Z v Z_{v} and motion tokens Z m Z_{m} . A graph network encodes the rig into per-joint descriptors D D , using the joints’ 2D locations in the reference image, and these condition the motion branch; a graph-attention layer inside each Motion DiT block propagates features along the rig edges. blocks.en:
For motion generation, we use a text-conditioned flow-matching network ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) that generates joint trajectories for rigs with varying joint counts and skeletal connectivity.
A graph encoder maps the rig to per-joint descriptors, which condition a transformer denoiser throughout generation.
We train the rig encoder and motion denoiser from scratch on motion data before coupling them to video.

Across arbitrary rigs, joint counts and connectivity vary, and joint indices do not carry consistent semantic meaning.
We therefore encode a rig with J J joints into descriptors D ∈ ℝ J × d D\in\mathbb{R}^{J\times d} , one per joint. Each joint’s input combines its name, embedded with the video model’s frozen text encoder, its rest-pose geometry, its reference-image location when available, and a root, chain, or leaf indicator. Separate projections embed the text and geometric features, which are concatenated and fused through an MLP.
A graph attention network ( Brody et al., 2022 ) propagates the resulting tokens bidirectionally along the bones ℰ \mathcal{E} , capturing local skeletal relationships. Full self-attention then enables direct
communication between joints that are distant in the hierarchy. The resulting descriptors are shared across frames and added to the corresponding motion tokens through a learned projection at each denoiser block. Since D D depends only on the rig and reference-image joint locations, it is computed once and reused throughout sampling (App. A.2 ).

blocks.en: 3.4 Training Data
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训数据

blocks.en:
To our knowledge, there exists no corpus that pairs natural video with 3D motion for arbitrary rigs.
We therefore build and annotate about 200K video–motion pairs from complementary sources.
Human video has rich scenes and interactions, but limited skeletal diversity.
Animated assets from Objaverse ( Deitke et al., 2023b ) and Objaverse-XL ( Deitke et al., 2023a ) span a wide range of skeletons with known 3D motion, but their animations often depict simple actions and their renders lack natural scene context.
blocks.zh:
据我们所知, 没有任何实体 将自然视频 与3D运动 任意钻机。
因此,我们从互补来源建立并注释了大约200K的视频-动画配对。
人类视频有丰富的场景和互动,但骨骼多样性有限.
来自Objaverse(Deitke等人,2023b)和Objaverse-XL(Deitke等人,2023a)的动画资产横跨了已知的3D运动的广泛骨架,但他们的动画往往描绘的是简单的动作,其制作缺乏自然场景背景.

blocks.en:
One could place each asset in a 3D scene and render it.
But suitable scenes are scarce, hard to match to each action, and can still look synthetic.
Instead, we let a video model build the world around the motion.
We render each asset in a simple temporary setting, then use a vision-language model to describe its action and propose an environment in which it belongs.
A generative video editing model ( Liu et al., 2026 ) brings this environment into the rendered clip, pairing the visual richness of a generated scene with the known 3D motion of the source animation.
This turns isolated animated assets into a scalable source of realistic video–motion pairs across diverse rigs.
blocks.zh:
一个可以把每个资产放在3D场景中,并把它制作出来.
但是合适的场景是稀缺的,很难与每个动作相匹配,仍然可以看起来是合成的.
相反,我们让一个视频模型在运动周围构建世界.
我们把每一项资产置于一个简单的临时环境中,然后使用一种视觉语言模式来描述其行动并提出它所属的环境。
一个基因视频编辑模型(Liu et al., 2026)将这种环境带入了渲染的剪辑中,将一个生成的场景的视觉丰富性与已知的源动画的3D运动进行了配对.
这把孤立的动画资产变成了跨各种钻机的现实视频动画对的可伸缩来源。

blocks.en:
The central challenge is preserving the source motion and its agreement with the edited video, since editing can change the subject’s appearance, pose, or trajectory and invalidate its 3D annotations.
We compare pre- and post-edit masks to detect changes in the subject’s silhouette and image-space motion, and use a vision-language model to reject physically implausible results.
We also check that the camera remains static to avoid global image motion caused by camera drift.
Further details on these checks are provided in App. A.6 .
Eligible failed clips are regenerated with new random seeds.
By showing assets in realistic scenes, we aim to narrow the visual gap to scenes seen at inference. The resulting dataset, “Objaverse in Video” (OiV), contains 118K videos from 43K assets.
blocks.zh:
中心挑战在于保留源动及其与编辑的视频的一致,因为编辑可以改变主题的外观,姿势,或轨迹,使其3D说明无效.
我们比较编辑前和编辑后的口罩,以检测对象的静音和图像空间运动的变化,并使用视觉语言模型来拒绝物理上不可信的结果.
我们还检查摄像头是否保持静止,以避免摄像头漂移引起的全球影像运动.
关于这些检查的进一步详情见App。 页:1
符合条件的失败剪辑会用新的随机种子重新生成.
通过在现实的场景中展示资产,我们的目标是将视觉差距缩小到推论中看到的场景. 由此产生的数据集“Objaverse in Video”(OiV)载有来自43K资产的118K视频。

blocks.en:
We complement OiV with 60K human video clips for which we reconstruct body and hand motion, and 27K robot video clips with motion obtained from their kinematic models, yielding approximately 200K video–motion pairs in total.
For motion-only pretraining, we additionally use 125K motion sequences, including human motions retargeted to randomized humanoid rigs with varying joint counts, connectivity, and geometry.
This leverages the richness of human motion to expand skeletal diversity without requiring additional motion capture or paired videos.
Qualitative examples are available on our project page .
blocks.zh:
我们用60K的人类视频片段来补充OiV, 我们重建身体和手动, 以及27K机器人视频片段, 从他们的运动模型中获得运动, 共产生约200K的视频 - 运动对。
对于只进行运动的预训,我们额外使用125K运动序列,包括人类运动重定向于随机化的人形钻机,其联合计数,连通性,几何学等各不相同.
这利用了人类运动的丰富性来扩展骨骼多样性而不需要额外的运动捕捉或配对视频.
定性实例见项目网页。

blocks.en: 3.5 Training
blocks.zh: 3.5 培训

blocks.en: We train the motion denoiser and rig encoder from scratch, and separately adapt the video backbone with LoRA. Joint training then updates these two, the LoRA adapters, the cross-modal bridges, and the localization head, leaving the base video weights frozen; captions, the reference image with its 2D joint coordinates, and the bridges are randomly dropped, and in some steps one modality is kept clean to serve as a condition. See App. A.7 for details.
blocks.zh: 我们从零开始训练运动引擎和钻机编码器, 并单独调整视频主干线与LORA。 然后联合训练更新这两个,LORA适配器,跨模式桥,以及本地化头,使基座视频重量冻结;字幕,带有其2D联合坐标的参考图像,桥梁随机投放,在某些步骤中,一种方式保持清洁,以作为条件. 详情见A.7.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We demonstrate that JCA outperforms video-first and mesh-based baselines in text-driven rig animation and, after fine-tuning, surpasses a human-specific model for joint motion–video generation. It also enables scene-aware, conditional, keyframe-controlled, and image-based animation. Quantitative evaluations and qualitative comparisons show that its motion follows text faithfully, preserves asset geometry, stays synchronized with generated video, and responds to the surrounding scene.
blocks.zh: 我们证明,JCA在文字驱动的钻机动画中超越了基于视频和网格的基线,并在微调后超越了人类特有的联合运动-视频生成模型。 它还可以使场景感知,有条件的,按键框控制的,以及基于图像的动画. 定量评价和定性比较显示其运动忠实地遵循文字,保存资产几何,与生成的视频保持同步,并响应周围场景.

blocks.en: 4.1 Rig Animation
blocks.zh: 4.1 硬动画

blocks.en:
We evaluate how effectively our generated motion animates diverse rigged assets from text. We randomly sample 20 assets from the Puppeteer test set ( Song et al., 2025 ) and use GPT-5.6 Sol to generate five action prompts per asset, giving 100 asset–prompt pairs. We compare against AnimateAnyMesh ( Wu et al., 2025 ) and ActionMesh ( Sabathier et al., 2026 ) , which animate mesh vertices without a rig, and Puppeteer ( Song et al., 2025 ) , which animates the ground-truth rig. We exclude AnimaX ( Huang et al., 2025 ) because its code, weights, and evaluation benchmark are not publicly available.
Puppeteer and ActionMesh recover motion from a generated guiding video, representing video-first pipelines. All methods start from the same posed asset:
the baselines receive the 3D asset, whereas
our method receives the rest-pose rig, a rendered image and its 2D joint positions.
blocks.zh:
我们评价我们产生的运动动画如何有效地激发了文本中的各种操纵资产。 我们从Puppeteer测试集(Song等人,2025年)中随机抽取20项资产,并使用GPT-5.6 Sol生成每笔资产5个动作提示,给出100个资产-即时对. 我们比较了Animate Anymesh(吴等人,2025年)和ActionMesh(萨巴蒂耶等人,2026年),前者将无钻机的网状顶点做成动画,后者则将无钻机的网状顶点做成动画(宋等人,2025年)。 我们排除了AnimaX(Huang等人,2025年),因为其代码、权重和评价基准不公开。

We evaluate prompt adherence with GPT-6 Astra as a multimodal judge, since text-driven motion has no ground truth. The judge scores each animation against its prompt from 0 to 100, blind to method identity ( appendix B ).
We measure how well the asset’s geometry is preserved, because vertex-based methods can violate it, and report mesh distortion: the median absolute change in edge length relative to the first frame. Finally, we report VBench’s motion smoothness and dynamic degree ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , which together separate smooth motion from motion that barely moves.

我们评价作为多式联运法官的GPT-6 Astra迅速得到遵守,因为文本驱动的动议没有根据。 评委对每部动画的评分比从0到100,盲目识别方法(附录B).
我们测量资产几何保存的好坏,因为基于顶点的方法可以违反它,并报告网格扭曲:相对于第一个框架,边缘长度的中位绝对变化。 最后,我们报告V Bench运动的平滑度和动态度(Huang等人,2024年),它们共同将平滑运动和勉强运动分开。

blocks.en: Our method outperforms all baselines in prompt adherence by a wide margin, scoring 58.4 58.4 against 43.4 43.4 for the strongest baseline ( tables 1 and 3 ), with the lowest mesh distortion and the highest dynamic degree. The two strongest baselines recover motion from a video generated without knowledge of the rig, supporting our premise that the rig should inform generation rather than enter only afterward. AnimateAnyMesh is the smoothest, but its low dynamic degree shows that its motion is subtle.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法迅速比所有基线的遵守率要高,对最强基线(表1和表3)的比分是58.458.4比43.4,网格扭曲度最低,动态度最高。 两个最强的基线从一个不知情钻机的视频中回收运动,支持我们的前提,即钻机应告知生成者,而不是只输入之后。 Animate AnyMesh是最平滑的,但是它的低动态度表明它的运动是微妙的.

blocks.en: 4.2 Scene-Aware Rig Animation
blocks.zh: 4.2 场景智能Rig动画

blocks.en:
Prior work on arbitrary-rig animation, as discussed in section 2 , has focused on isolated meshes without considering their interaction with the surrounding environment.
Our training procedure and video-generation backbone enable our model to generate scene-aware motion.
Given a rigged asset and a 3D scene, we place the asset at a user-specified location and pose and render this configuration as the first frame. From a text prompt, the model then generates a video that respects the scene geometry, together with the corresponding 3D motion. For example, the ape in fig. 1 jumps over a crossbar, and the penguin in fig. 5 slides on its belly across the snow (more examples in our page ).

如第2节所讨论, 先前关于专制动画的作品,
我们的训练程序和视频生成主干能使我们的模型产生场景感知运动.
鉴于一个被操纵的资产和一个3D场景,我们将该资产置于一个用户指定的位置,并将这一配置作为第一个框架。 从文本提示开始,模型再生成一个尊重场景几何的视频,以及相应的3D运动. 例如无花果中的猿. 1跳过横杠,企鹅在无花果。 它的肚子上滑了5个滑块,

blocks.en: 4.3 Joint Generation for Humans
blocks.zh: 4.3 人类联合世代

blocks.en:
Our method is designed for arbitrary rigs. When using a human skeleton, it can be directly compared with EchoMotion ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , a human-specific model that jointly generates an RGB video and an SMPL motion sequence from text.
We evaluate two variants: our general model, JCA , and JCA SMPL-FT, obtained by fine-tuning the general checkpoint for 10K steps on our human subset using SMPL, the body model used by EchoMotion.
Both variants are evaluated on 250 prompts from the HumanML3D test split ( Guo et al., 2022 ) .
EchoMotion runs text-to-video, while we run ours with a generated reference image ( appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
我们的方法是为任意钻机设计的 在使用人骨架时,可以直接与EchoMotion(Yang等人,2026年)进行比较,这是一种人类特异性模型,从文本中联合生成RGB视频和SMPL运动序列.
我们评价两个变体:我们的一般型号JCA和JCA SMPL-FT,通过微调一般检查点获得,在人类子集上使用SMPL,EchoMotion所使用的体型.
这两种变体都通过HumanML3D测试分裂的250个提示(Guo等人,2022年)来评价.
EchoMotion运行着文本到视频,而我们运行着一个生成的参考图像(附录C).

blocks.en:
We evaluate synchronization, whether the generated motion matches the generated video, by recovering an SMPL trajectory from each video with GVHMR ( Shen et al., 2024 ) and comparing it with the generated one.
PA-MPJPE measures pose agreement after per-frame rigid alignment; SA-MPJPE and SA-MPJVE measure root-centered position and velocity agreement under a single rotation fitted over the sequence.
For video quality, we follow EchoMotion and report VBench metrics, adding the non-static camera rate since dynamic degree also counts camera motion ( appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
我们通过从每个视频中恢复一个SMPL轨迹与GVHMR(Shen等人,2024年),并把它与生成的视频进行比较,来评价同步,所生成的运动是否与生成的视频相匹配.
PA-MPJPE措施在每帧刚性对齐后形成协议;SA-MPJPE和SA-MPJVE在安装在序列上的单一旋转下测量根位和速度协议.
关于视频质量,我们遵循EchoMotion并报告V Bench 度量衡,加上非静态相机率,因为动态度也算相机运动(附录C).

blocks.en:
Without SMPL-specific fine-tuning, our general model trails EchoMotion in synchronization ( table 2 ). After fine-tuning, JCA SMPL-FT surpasses it on all three metrics, reducing PA-MPJPE by 26% and SA-MPJVE by 37%. Both variants produce markedly better human anatomy (.93 vs. .73) and higher aesthetic quality.
EchoMotion has a higher dynamic degree, but also a higher estimated non-static camera rate (74% versus about 45% for ours), so its greater dynamics may partly reflect camera movement.
blocks.zh:
没有SMPL的特异性微调,我们的一般模型在同步中跟踪回声运动(表2). 经过微调后,JCA SMPL-FT在所有三个度量标准上都超过了它,PA-MPJPE减少了26%,SA-MPJVE减少了37%. 这两个变体都产生了明显更好的人体解剖学(.93 vs.73)和更高的审美质量.
EchoMotion具有更高的动态程度,但也具有较高的非静态相机估计率(74%相对于我们约45%),因此其更大的动态可能部分反映相机运动.

blocks.en: 4.4 Video-to-Motion and Motion-to-Video.
blocks.zh: 4.4 影视动漫与影视动漫.

blocks.en:
Holding one modality clean and denoising only the other turns joint generation into conditional generation.
With a clean video, our model estimates motion for the supplied rig, and after fine-tuning it matches a dedicated video-to-motion method without receiving the first-frame pose (App. D ).
Conversely, given a 3D trajectory and its rig, together with a text prompt, we keep the motion fixed at zero noise and denoise only the video. The generated videos follow the supplied trajectory across arbitrary rigs, while the prompt determines how the subject looks and the environment it moves in. This works both with a first frame reference image ( fig. 1 ) and without one ( fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
拥有一种清洁模式,并且只否认另一种模式,将联合发电转变为有条件发电。
使用干净的视频,我们的模型估计了所供应的钻机的运动,经过微调后,它匹配了专用的视频对运动方法,而不接收第一帧的姿势(App. D.).
反之,由于3D轨迹和它的钻机,加上文字提示,我们把运动固定在零噪声下,只把视频遮住。 生成的视频遵循所提供轨迹穿越任意钻机,而提示则决定了主体的外观和环境的移动. 这既能使用第一个帧参考图像(图1),也能不使用一个(图. 页:1

blocks.en: 4.5 Keyframe-Controlled Motion.
blocks.zh: 4.5 关键框架控制动议。

blocks.en:
Our coupled model lets users guide a 3D animation through RGB keyframes, generating both video and motion between them without additional training.
Given a text prompt, a static rig, and RGB keyframes at specified temporal locations, we construct a sparse reference video by inserting the supplied images and filling the remaining frames with zeros in normalized image space.
Following Wan’s image-conditioning protocol, we provide the VAE-encoded reference video together with a temporal mask indicating the supplied keyframes.
The video and motion streams are then jointly denoised, allowing the visual keyframe conditions to guide the generated 3D rig trajectory through cross-modal coupling. No target 3D motion sequence or final-frame 3D pose is required.
Qualitative examples of keyframe-controlled generation are shown in fig. 1 .
blocks.zh:
我们的组合型号让用户通过RGB键框来引导一个3D动画,在没有额外训练的情况下在它们之间产生视频和运动.
鉴于文字提示、静态钻机和RGB键框在特定的时间位置,我们通过在正常的图像空间中插入所提供的图像并用零填充其余的帧来构建一个稀少的参考视频。
根据Wan的图像调节协议, 我们提供VAE编码的参考视频,
然后视频和运动流被联合解析,使视觉键框条件能够通过跨模式耦合引导生成的3D钻机轨迹. 不需要目标3D运动序列或最终帧3D姿势.

blocks.en: 5.2 Motion Only

To assess the benefit of our full video–motion model,
we compare our model with its motion-only pretrained checkpoint, trained using only motion supervision.
We evaluate both models using the protocol of section 4.1 with matched sampling settings.
The jointly trained model raises prompt adherence from 51.6 to 58.4 and dynamic degree from .72 to .83, while mesh distortion stays low for both (0.14% and 0.20%).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion, Limitations, and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论、限制和未来工作

blocks.en:
We presented JCA , a model that co-generates video and 3D motion for arbitrary rigs, from humans and robots to animals.
We pretrain a rig-conditioned motion denoiser on motion alone, then connect it to a pretrained video generator through zero-initialized bidirectional cross-attention.
This design combines motion and video priors at modest parameter cost, while bridge guidance strengthens their interaction at inference.
A joint-localization head provides 2D–3D correspondences for camera fitting, aligning the generated motion with the depicted scene.
To support training across diverse rigs, we introduced OiV, pairing known 3D asset animations with videos edited into scenes suited to each asset and its action.
In text-driven rig animation, our method achieves stronger prompt adherence and lower mesh distortion than the evaluated video-first and mesh-based baselines.
The same framework also supports video-to-motion and motion-to-video generation, and lets users guide 3D animation through RGB keyframes.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了JCA, 一个将视频和3D运动 用于任意钻机的模型, 从人类和机器人到动物。
我们独自训练一个装有机具的运动装置 然后通过零启动双向交叉式 将它连接到一个预先训练的视频生成器上
这种设计以适度的参数成本将运动前传和视频前传结合起来,而桥导则在推论上加强它们的互动.
联合定位头为相机安装提供2D–3D通信,使生成的运动与所描绘的场景一致.
为了支持跨各种钻机的培训,我们推出了OiV,将已知的3D资产动画与经过编辑的视频配对成适合每个资产及其行动的场景.
在文字驱动的钻机动画中,我们的方法实现了比评估的视频第一和网基基线更强的即时遵守和降低网格扭曲.
同一框架还支持视频对动和动作对视频生成,让用户通过RGB键框来引导3D动画.

blocks.en:
Limitations and future work. Our alignment procedure assumes a static camera at inference time; extending it to moving cameras would support more general scenes.
Our training rigs also skew toward bipeds: most animated Objaverse characters are bipedal with a limited range of actions, and our additional motion-only data consists of humanoid motion.
While video priors broaden what these rigs can do, there is room to strengthen this transfer and better preserve the video model’s capabilities.
While the generated motion responds to the scene, the scene reaches it only through the video: the model never sees the 3D scene geometry, so nothing enforces contact or prevents penetration. Conditioning the motion branch on that geometry, or adding contact terms during training or guidance, could turn scene-consistent video into physically consistent 3D motion.
Finally, objects the subject interacts with move in the video but are not recovered in 3D, and each clip animates a single rig. Lifting both is an exciting direction, taking co-generation from animating an asset to animating a scene.

blocks.en: A.3 Motion Denoiser
blocks.zh: A.3 Denoiser动议

blocks.en: The backbone contains ten blocks with hidden width 384. Each block applies five operations in order: global self-attention over all joints and frames; cross-attention to the encoded text prompt; a feed-forward update; graph attention along the rig’s connectivity within each frame; and a second feed-forward update. Global self-attention operates at width 512 with eight heads, using linear projections to and from the backbone width. Text cross-attention and graph attention use six heads at width 384, and both feed-forward networks have hidden width 1536.
blocks.zh: 骨干包含10个块,隐藏宽度384. 每个区块按以下顺序进行五种操作:所有关节和框架的全球自我注意;对编码文本提示的交叉注意;向导更新;在每个框架内沿钻机连接图示注意;第二次向导更新。 全球自觉运行宽度512,有8个头,使用线性预测往返于骨干宽度. 文字交叉注意和图表注意使用6个头,宽384,两个向导网络都有隐藏宽度1536.

blocks.en: The rig descriptors are shared across blocks, while each block learns its own linear projection. At the start of each block, the projected descriptor of joint j j is added to that joint’s tokens at every frame.
blocks.zh: 钻机描述符在区块之间共享,而每个区块学习自己的线性投影. 在每一区块开始时,联合jj的预测描述符都会在每个区块的标志上加入。

blocks.en: The noise level s s is encoded using a sinusoidal embedding followed by an MLP. The resulting features determine normalization scales and shifts, together with residual gates, for global self-attention, graph attention, and their feed-forward updates. Text cross-attention uses a separate pre-normalization and an ungated residual connection.
blocks.zh: 噪声级别s的编码使用sinusoidal嵌入法,然后是MLP. 由此产生的特征决定了正常化的尺度和变化,以及剩余大门,以便全球自觉,图示注意,以及它们向反馈的更新。 文本的交叉注意使用单独的前常态化和加成的剩余连接.

blocks.en: Separate input and output MLPs serve the root and non-root joints, with the latter shared across all non-root joints. The output MLPs predict flow velocities in the standardized feature space of App. A.1 . After denoising, we reverse the standardization and decode the rotations and positions. The root trajectory is reconstructed by accumulating the predicted frame-to-frame displacements, starting from the predicted initial root position. World-space joint positions are obtained using this trajectory and the predicted root rotations. For the final output, we fit the decoded joint positions to the rig’s fixed bone lengths using inverse kinematics.
blocks.zh: 单独的输入和输出MLP服务于根部和非根部关节,后者共享于所有非根部关节. 输出的 MLPs 预测App 的标准化特征空间中的流量速度. A.1 国家 在解密之后,我们扭转标准化,并解码轮调和职位。 根轨迹的重建是通过从最初的预测根位开始,积累预测的帧到帧的迁移. 利用这一轨迹和预测的根旋转获得世界-空间联合位置。 对于最后的输出,我们用逆动因子将解码的联结位置与钻机的固定骨长相匹配。

blocks.en: A.4 Coupling Video and Motion
blocks.zh: A.4 视频和动画

blocks.en: Each of the motion denoiser’s blocks is paired with one block of the video backbone. The pairings are spread approximately uniformly through the backbone and include its first and last blocks.
blocks.zh: 每个运动的Denoiser区块都与一个区块的视频主干网成对。 配对在骨干中大致统一分布,并包括它的第一和最后一块.

blocks.en: At a paired block, both branches have already normalized their hidden states and modulated them by their own noise level, as a DiT block does just before self-attention. These modulated states are the H ¯ v \bar{H}_{v} and H ¯ m \bar{H}_{m} of Sec. 3.2 ; because each branch carries its own noise level, each side exchanges features that reflect its own progress through denoising. The query, key, and value projections of each direction map both modalities into a shared attention space.
blocks.zh: 在一个对齐的区块上,两个分支已经实现了它们隐藏状态的正常化,并以它们自己的噪音水平来调节它们,就像一个DiT区块在自我注意之前所做的那样. 这些调制的状态是3.2sec的H' v\bar{H}_{v}和H' m\bar{H}_{m};因为每个分支都带有自己的噪声级别,所以每个侧面的交换特征都通过调音来反映自己的进步. 每个方向的查询、关键和价值预测将两种模式映射到一个共同的注意空间。

blocks.en: Both directions apply query–key normalization before the dot product.
blocks.zh: 两个方向在点产品之前应用查询 - 键态 。

blocks.en: The branches sample time at different densities: the motion branch keeps one entry per video frame, whereas the video branch works in latent frames, one per four video frames after the first. Cross-modal attention expresses both in latent-frame units, giving latent frame f f the coordinate f f and motion frame n n the coordinate n / 4 n/4 , and the temporal rotary embeddings act on these coordinates. The attention is not masked by frame: a joint may attend to patches from any moment of the clip, not only the moment it is predicting.
blocks.zh: 不同密度的分支采样时间:运动分支每个视频帧保留一个条目,而视频分支则在潜在帧中工作,第一个视频帧后每四个视频帧就有一个. 跨模式的注意在潜在框架单元中表示,使潜在框架f f 坐标f 和运动框架n 坐标n / 4 n/4 ,以及时间旋转嵌入作用在这些坐标上. 注意力没有被帧遮掩:一个关节可能从剪辑的任意时刻,而不仅仅是它所预言的瞬间,去处理补丁.

blocks.en: This positional encoding is temporal only, and joint indices receive no spatial coordinates. What a joint is, and how it sits in the rig, reaches the attention through the rig descriptors already carried by the motion features (Sec. 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: 这种位置编码只有时间性,联合指数没有获得空间坐标. 关节是什么以及它是如何在钻机中坐着的,通过运动特征已经携带的钻机描述符(Sec. 3.1)。

The bridge guidance of Sec. 3.2 applies at inference only.
Our formulation uses four predictions: the text prompt or empty prompt, each with the bridges enabled or disabled.
Text guidance is applied within each bridge state, and the change between the two guided predictions is then scaled.
The scales are specified per modality, so the influence of motion on video and of video on motion can be set independently.
We set ω text , i = 3 \omega_{\mathrm{text},i}=3 and ω bridge , i = 2 \omega_{\mathrm{bridge},i}=2 for both modalities.
Training also disables the bridges (App. A.7 ), so the disconnected state occurs during training as well as at inference.

During training, the head operates on the final-layer features at the noise levels sampled for that step and predicts clean 2D joint locations. These predictions are supervised with a smooth- L 1 L_{1} loss against annotations at motion frames 4 ​ f 4f .
For training assets, the 2D annotations are obtained by projecting the ground-truth 3D joints with the given rendering camera (Sec. 3.4 ).

At inference, we average the head’s 2D predictions over the second half of the denoising steps.

We fit a single perspective camera using a reliability-weighted robust reprojection objective, estimating rotation, translation, and focal length while fixing the principal point at the image center.
Correspondences near image borders are excluded, temporal outliers are downweighted, and spatial weighting reduces the influence of densely clustered joints.

blocks.en: A.6 Data
blocks.zh: A.6 数据

blocks.en: All sources below are converted into the motion representation of Sec. 3.1 ; the video sources also carry 2D joint annotations.
blocks.zh: 以下所有来源被转换为Sec. 3.1的动作代表;视频来源还带有2D联合说明.

blocks.en: We start from Diffusion4D’s curated animated-asset lists, 82K candidates drawn from Objaverse-1.0 and Objaverse-XL. Each imported asset is inspected automatically. During processing, we remove joints with zero or negligible skinning weight on the mesh, and keep assets with a usable remaining skeleton, visible animated geometry, and usable motion. The original rigs are stored separately from the processed representations.
blocks.zh: 从Divusion4D的动画资产名单开始, 每个进口资产都自动检查。 在加工过程中,我们去除网格上零或可忽略不计的剥皮重量的关节,并将资产保留在可用的剩余骨架,可见动画几何,可用运动. 原钻机与处理过的表示材料分开存放.

blocks.en: Source animations do not always preserve bone lengths, so each trajectory is rebuilt. Joint positions are recomputed along the skeleton hierarchy from the source rotations and the bone offsets of frame zero. A root-relative rest skeleton is then derived from the source rest directions and these fixed lengths, and the source rotations are re-expressed in it. Finally, we place the floor at zero, align the vertical axis to + Y +Y , remove horizontal camera yaw, and project the finalized 3D joints with the recorded camera to obtain the 2D annotations.
blocks.zh: 源动画并不总是保存骨长,所以每个轨迹都会重建. 联合位置从源旋转和帧0的骨折抵消上按照骨架等级重算. 然后从源休方向和这些固定长度中衍生出一个根-相对的休息骨架,并在其中重新表达源旋转. 最后,我们把地板设为零,将垂直轴线与+Y+Y对齐,去掉水平相机yaw,并与录制的相机投影最终的3D关节,以获得2D说明.

blocks.en: Each asset is rendered up to four times, with randomized camera viewpoint, distance, framing, and lighting direction and intensity. The subject is rendered against a temporary checkerboard floor and backdrop, which gives the editor explicit ground-plane and perspective cues. The floor is omitted for motion that does not touch it, such as flying or hovering.
blocks.zh: 每件资产最多可兑换四倍,随机照相机视距、距离、框架、照明方向和强度。 题材是在临时的跳板地板和背景下制作的,这给编辑提供了明确的地盘和视角提示. 地板因不触摸它而省略,如飞行或徘徊.

blocks.en: Cap3D ( Luo et al., 2023 ) and DiffuRank ( Luo et al., 2025 ) provide captions for the Objaverse assets, but these captions mainly describe their static appearance. We use Qwen ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) to choose an environment that fits each asset and to describe the action in its rendered clip. We then combine the object, action, and environment descriptions into the editing instruction used to generate the scene. To increase environmental diversity while preserving the subject and its action, we vary the phrasing, add local scene details, and substitute related environment subtypes.
blocks.zh: Cap3D(Luo等人,2023年)和DiffuRank(Luo等人,2025年)为Objaverse资产提供了标题,但这些标题主要描述了它们的静态外观. 我们利用Quen(Quen Team, 2026)来选择一个适合每个资产的环境,并描述其渲染片段中的动作. 然后,我们将对象、动作和环境描述合并到用于生成场景的编辑指令中。 为了在保留主题及其行动的同时增加环境多样性,我们修改了措辞,增加了局部场景细节,并替代了相关的环境子类型.

blocks.en: The video editor, Bernini ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , receives the rendered clip and an instruction to replace the temporary setting while preserving the subject’s appearance, silhouette, position in frame, apparent scale, pose timing, and motion. These preservation constraints are stated explicitly in the editing prompt. To keep the recorded camera valid, we retain only clips generated under fixed-camera instructions, and we exclude clips classified as in-place locomotion.
blocks.zh: 录像编辑Bernini(Liu等人,2026年)收到剪辑片段和指示,以取代临时设置,同时保留主题的外观、轮廓、框架位置、明显尺度、时机和动作。 这些保存方面的限制在编辑时作了明确说明。 为了保持录制的相机有效,我们只保留根据固定相机指令生成的剪辑,并且我们排除了被归类为在位电机的剪辑.

blocks.en:
We use VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025 ) to estimate camera motion and reject clips with camera drift, which would invalidate the recorded camera and introduce unmodeled global image motion.
More importantly, we compare SAM ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) segmentations before and after editing to detect changes in the subject’s silhouette and image-space motion; otherwise, the 2D joint annotations obtained from the render would no longer match the edited video. Finally, we ask Qwen whether the edited result is physically plausible, filtering cases such as a person appearing to walk in the air.
An eligible clip that fails these checks is regenerated with a new random seed and checked again. For each asset and render variant we keep the first attempt that passes, so retries never add examples. The resulting OiV dataset contains 118K videos from 43K assets and covers rigs with 2 to 256 joints and is partitioned into 110K training, 4,000 validation, and 4,000 test examples, with all variants of an asset assigned to the same split.
blocks.zh:
我们使用VGGT(Wang等人,2025年)来估计相机运动,并用相机漂移来拒绝剪辑,这将会使录制的相机失效,引入无模型的全球影像运动.
更重要的是,我们比较编辑前后的SAM(Ravi等人,2025年)片段,以发现主题的硅和图像空间运动的变化;否则,从渲染中获取的2D联合说明将不再符合编辑过的视频. 最后,我们问Quen,编辑的结果在物理上是否可信,过滤一些案件,例如有人出现在空中。
无法进行这些检查的合格剪辑会重新生成一个新的随机种子, 并再次检查 。 对于每一个资产和变体,我们保留了第一次尝试 通过,所以回顾 从来没有增加的例子。 由此产生的OiV数据集包含来自43K资产的118K视频,并覆盖有2至256关节的钻机,并被分为110K训练,4000验证,4000测试实例,一个资产的所有变体被分配到同一个拆分.

blocks.en:
Real human video datasets with 3D motion offer natural scenes and motion, but no such dataset is publicly available online at scale ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
Human-action clips come from OpenVid and HAA500 ( Nan et al., 2024 ; Chung et al., 2021 ) ; the joint-training set contains 57K OpenVid clips and 3,500 HAA500 clips. Neither provides motion in our rig representation, so we construct it: SAM-Body4D reconstructs the body, tracking the person through the whole clip and handling occlusion, and a quality-aware pipeline based on Dyn-HaMR reconstructs the hands ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025b ) .
EchoMotion and CoMoVi annotate body motion; our annotations additionally include articulated hands.
Accepted trajectories then receive hand refinement and planted-foot post-processing, after which we construct a fixed-bone rest skeleton and derive the corresponding joint rotations.
From HAA500 we keep only clips with one dominant person and an approximately static camera. The reconstructed trajectories and estimated cameras provide aligned 3D and 2D annotations. Captions come from OpenVid directly and from Motion-X++ for HAA500 ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) ; mismatched or uncertain HAA500 captions are replaced with descriptions based on the action class.
blocks.zh:
具有3D运动的真人视频数据集提供自然场景和运动,但没有此类数据集可在网上公开(Yang等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年a; 张等,2025).
人类动作片段来自OpenVid和HAA500(Nan等人,2024年;Chung等人,2021年);联合培训集包含 57K OpenVid剪辑和3500个HAA500剪辑. 我们的钻机代表也没有提供运动,所以我们建造了它:SAM-Body4D重建机体,通过整个机匣跟踪人员并进行掩蔽处理,以及基于Dyn-HAMR的具有质量意识的管道重建手(Gao等人,2025年;Yu等人,2025年b) 。
Echo Motion and CoMoVi 注释体动;我们的注解还包括手声明。
接受的轨迹然后得到手的精炼和植入脚的后处理,然后我们再构筑一个固定骨架并得出相应的联合旋转.
从HAA500开始,我们只保留一个占支配地位的人和一个大约静止的相机的片段. 重建后的轨迹和估计相机提供对齐的3D和2D说明. 说明直接来自OpenVid和HAA500(张等人,2025年)的Motion-QQ;不匹配或不确定的HAA500标题被基于动作类的描述所取代.

blocks.en: Robotic manipulation sequences, real and simulated, come from DROID, ALOHA, RoboCerebra, and TAVIS ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Spigler, 2026 ) . The joint-training set contains 25K DROID clips, 50 ALOHA clips, 912 RoboCerebra clips, and 570 TAVIS clips. Their 3D joint trajectories are computed using each dataset’s kinematic model. We transform the trajectories into our training coordinate convention and project them to the camera plane to obtain 2D annotations. The original task descriptions serve as text conditioning.
blocks.zh: 真正的和模拟的机器人操纵序列来自DROID、ALOHA、RoboCerebra和TAVIS(Khazatsky等人,2024年;Fu等人,2024年;Han等人,2025年;Spigler,2026年)。 联合训练集包含25K DROID剪辑,50个ALOHA剪辑,912个RoboCerebra剪辑,以及570个TAVIS剪辑. 它们的3D联合轨迹是使用每个数据集的运动模型计算出来的。 我们把轨迹转换成我们的训练坐标会议 把它们投射到摄像机上 得到2D说明 最初的任务描述起到文本调制的作用.

blocks.en:
Motion pretraining is augmented with two further sources that carry 3D motion but no video. To broaden the range of skeletal structures, we retarget BONES-SEED motions ( Bones Studio, 2026 ) to randomized variants of the SOMA humanoid Saito et al. (2026) , yielding 100K augmented motion sequences across 10,000 randomized rigs. The variants change body proportions, split or merge body segments, and optionally remove the head, while keeping a torso, two arms, and two legs. Each motion is retargeted with PyRoki ( Kim et al., 2025 ) by matching corresponding body keypoints, which yields motion across varied proportions and joint layouts without collecting additional video.
We also use 25K sequences from the official HumanML3D training split ( Guo et al., 2022 ) , converting its 22-joint sequences into our motion representation.
blocks.zh:
增加了两个载有3D运动但没有录像的资料来源。 为了扩大骨骼结构的范围,我们重新将BONES-SEED运动(Bones Studio, 2026)瞄准SOMA人造Saito等人(2026)的随机变体,在10,000个随机钻机上产生100K增殖运动序列. 变体会改变身体比例,分裂或合并身体部分,可选取头部,同时保留躯干,两臂,两腿. 每个运动通过匹配对应的车体键点而与PyRoki(Kim 等人,2025年)重新对准目标,该键点在不收集额外视频的情况下产生不同比例和联合布局的运动.
我们还使用官方HumanML3D训练分裂(Guo等人,2022年)的25K序列,将其22联序列转换为我们的运动代表.

blocks.en: A.7 Training
blocks.zh: A.7 培训

blocks.en:
We use AdamW with no warmup, running each stage on 32 NVIDIA H100 80GB GPUs.
Motion pretraining runs for 200,000 updates on motion sequences from the paired corpus together with additional unpaired motion data, using learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} and a global batch size of 256. Separately, the pretrained Wan2.2 I2V-A14B backbone is adapted to our video corpus with rank-32 LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) for 10,000 updates, using the same learning rate and a global batch size of 32, without motion conditioning. Both branches use flow-matching objectives.
blocks.zh:
我们使用没有热身的亚当W,在32 NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU上运行每个舞台.
运动预训从配对体中进行20万个运动序列更新,加上附加的未发动数据,使用学习速率10−4 10^{-4}以及全球批量大小256. 另外,经过预训的Wan2.2 I2V-A14B骨干也适应我国的视频机体,配有等级为32的LORA适配器(Hu等人,2022年),用于1万台更新,采用相同的学习率,全球批量规模为32台,不设运动调节. 两个分支都采用流量匹配目标.

blocks.en:
During joint training, we update the motion denoiser, the rig encoder, the cross-modal bridges, the localization head, and the rank-32 video LoRA adapters, while the base video weights, the VAE, and the text encoder remain frozen.
These components total 331.28M trainable parameters: 153.35M in the video LoRA adapters, 115.45M in the video–motion cross-attention layers, 56.06M in the motion model, including the 2D prediction head, and 6.41M in the rig encoder.
The backbone holds two expert denoisers covering different noise ranges; they share a single set of LoRA parameters, and we select the high-noise expert when s v ≥ 0.9 s_{v}\geq 0.9 and the low-noise expert otherwise. The loss combines the standard flow-matching loss of each branch with the smooth- L 1 L_{1} localization loss of Sec. 3.3 .
blocks.zh:
在联合训练期间,我们更新了运动denoiser,钻机编码器,跨模式桥,本地化头,以及排名32的视频LORA适配器,而基视频重量,VAE,文本编码器仍然被冻结.
这些组件共331.28M可列车参数:视频LORA适配器153.35M,视频-运动横切层115.45M,运动模型56.06M,包括2D预测头,钻机编码器6.41M.
骨干拥有两个覆盖不同噪声范围的专家Denoisers;他们共享一套LORA参数,我们在S v 0.9 s_{v}\geq 0.9时选择了高噪声专家,另选低噪声专家. 损失将每个分支的标准流量比对损失与光滑-L 1 L_{1} 本地化损失3.3 Sec.

blocks.en:
Conditions are dropped at random during training.
We replace both captions with empty captions with probability 0.05 0.05 , only the video caption with probability 0.05 0.05 , and only the motion caption with probability 0.05 0.05 ; these three cases are mutually exclusive.
The reference image and its 2D joint coordinates are dropped together with probability 0.20 0.20 to support generation without reference-image conditioning.
We disable the cross-modal bridges with probability 0.10 0.10 , which lets both branches continue learning independently and enables bridge guidance (Sec. 3.2 ).
We keep motion clean with probability 0.10 0.10 and video clean with probability 0.10 0.10 ; these two cases and bridge dropout are mutually exclusive.
This exposes the model to conditioning on a fully observed video or motion, which enables video-to-motion and motion-to-video generation at inference.
blocks.zh:
培训期间随意放弃条件。
我们用空字幕替换两个标题,用概率0.05 0.05,只有视频字幕用概率0.05 0.05,只有运动字幕用概率0.05 0.05;这三种情况是相互排斥的。
参考图像及其2D联合坐标与概率0.20 0.20一起投放,以支持生成而无需参考图像配置.
我们以 0. 10 0. 10 的概率禁用跨模式桥,使两个分支能够继续独立学习,并实现桥面指引(第3.2条)。
我们保持运动清洁 概率0.100.10,录像清洁 概率0.100.10; 这两个病例和桥断是相互排斥的。
这让模型在完全被观测到的视频或运动上进行调制,从而可以推论到视频到运动和动向视频生成.

blocks.en:
Joint training uses a global batch size of 32.
We use a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the first 50,000 updates, then reduce it to 10 − 5 10^{-5} , which is also used for the fine-tuning experiments.
At this transition, we increase the video flow-loss weight from 1 to 10, while keeping the motion flow-loss and localization-loss weights at 1.
We report results from the checkpoint at joint-training step 70,000.
blocks.zh:
联合培训使用全球批量32个。
我们使用10 - 4 10 - 4 10 - 4}的学习率来进行最初的5万个更新,然后将其降低到10 - 5 10 - 5 5},这也用于微调实验.
在这个过渡中,我们把视频流量减重从1提高到10,同时将运动流量减重和本地化减重保持在1.
我们报告70 000人联合训练步骤检查站的结果。

blocks.en:
Following the hybrid configuration of EchoMotion ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , we estimate the cost of adding motion-specific weights to 20 of our video backbone’s 40 blocks.
At hidden width 5120 and feed-forward width 13824, the additional attention, feed-forward, normalization, and modulation parameters total approximately 351.4M per block, or 7.03B across 20 blocks.
This estimate excludes motion input/output and conditioning modules and counts a single set of motion weights shared across the two video experts.
Our motion denoiser, rig encoder, localization head, and bridges together contain 177.92M parameters; including video LoRA adapters brings the total trainable count to 331.28M.
blocks.zh:
在EchoMotion(Yang等人,2026年)的混合配置之后,我们估算了在视频主干线的40个街区中增加20个运动特定权重的成本.
在隐藏宽度5120和饲料前进宽度13824时,额外的注意,饲料前进,正常化,调制参数共约每块351.4M,或跨20块7.03B.
这一估计数不包括运动输入/输出和调制模块,并计算出两个视频专家共有的一套运动权重。
我们的动因器、钻机编码器、本地化头和桥梁共含有177.92M参数;包括视频LORA适配器,使可列车总数达到331.28M。

blocks.en: Appendix B Rig-Animation Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B Rig动画 评价细节

blocks.en: We provide additional details for the rig-animation experiment described in section 4.1 , in which each method animates 20 assets from five text prompts each.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了第4.1节所述钻机动能试验的更多细节,在试验中,每种方法从5个文字中动画出20个资产。

blocks.en: B.1 Baseline Setup
blocks.zh: B.1 基线设置

blocks.en: We verify each selected asset against our training data and exclude any confirmed or unresolved identity overlap. The same check is not possible for ActionMesh because its training data include Objaverse-derived assets. Some evaluated meshes or initial poses may therefore have been seen during training, although all action prompts are newly written.
blocks.zh: 我们对照我们的培训数据核查每个选定的资产,排除任何确认或未解决的身份重叠。 ActionMesh不可能进行同样的检查,因为其培训数据包括Objaverse衍生资产。 因此,在培训期间可能会看到一些被评估的网格或初步姿势,尽管所有动作提示都是新写的。

blocks.en:
AnimateAnyMesh is rig-free and receives the posed mesh and action prompt, while ActionMesh receives the posed mesh together with a guiding video, a generated video of the requested action described below. In both cases, the mesh coordinates explicitly provide the initial 3D pose. Because our method assumes a supplied rig, we bypass Puppeteer’s automatic-rigging stage and provide it with the ground-truth skeleton and skinning weights, initializing its video-guided optimization from the same first-frame 3D pose. Thus, all three baselines receive the initial 3D pose explicitly, either through mesh coordinates or optimization initialization.
Our method is rig-based but does not receive the initial posed joints in 3D. Instead, it receives the rig’s rest pose, hierarchy, and semantic joint names, together with a reference image, the initial joints’ 2D projections, and an action prompt. The model does not observe mesh geometry or skinning weights; the latter are used only after inference to render the predicted joint motion on the asset.
blocks.zh:
Animate AnyMesh是无钻井的,接收了被设置的网格和动作提示,而ActionMesh则接收被设置的网格和导引视频,这是以下描述的所请求动作的生成视频. 在这两种情况下,网格坐标都明确提供了初始的3D姿势. 由于我们的方法假设了供应的钻机,我们绕过了Puppeteer的自动操纵阶段,并提供了地面真骨架和剥皮重量,从相同的第一帧3D姿势初始化了它的视频制导优化. 因此,所有三个基线都通过网格坐标或优化初始化,明确得到初始立体。
我们的方法以钻机为基础,但并没有收到3D中最初提出的关节. 相反,它得到了钻机的剩余位置、等级和语义联合名称,以及参考图像、最初的关节2D预测和动作提示。 该模型不观测网格几何或剥皮重量;只有在推论后才使用后者来对资产作出预测的联合运动.

blocks.en: Neither the Puppeteer nor ActionMesh release provides specific implementation of the original video-generation component. We therefore generate the guiding videos for both methods using Wan2.2-I2V-A14B. For each asset–prompt pair, both baselines receive exactly the same video, generated from the same render of the posed asset and the action prompt. This protocol controls the visual motion signal and isolates differences in how the methods recover an animation from it.
blocks.zh: 无论是傀儡还是行动 网格发布提供了原始视频生成组件的具体实施. 因此,我们用Wan2.2-I2V-A14B制作两种方法的指导视频。 对于每对资产 -- -- 即时对等 -- -- ,两个基线都接收到完全相同的视频,这些视频来自被设定资产的相同渲染度,而且动作迅速。 这个协议控制了视觉运动信号,并隔离了方法如何从中恢复动画的不同.

blocks.en: AnimateAnyMesh produces 16 frames at 10 FPS, corresponding to approximately 1.6 seconds. To match this duration while retaining our native temporal configuration, we generate 25 frames at 16 FPS. For a fair comparison, we provide Puppeteer and ActionMesh with the same 25-frame, 16-FPS guiding videos. Thus, all methods produce animations of approximately the same duration.
blocks.zh: Animate AnyMesh在10 FPS中产生16帧,对应约1.6秒. 为了配合这个持续时间,同时保留我们的本土时间配置,我们以16 FPS生成25帧. 为了进行公平的比较,我们向Puppeteer和ActionMesh提供同样的25帧,16FPS指导视频. 因此,所有方法的动画制作时间都大致相同.

blocks.en: B.2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: B.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: All animations are rendered from the front, right, and left views with the same Three.js viewer at 768 × 768 768\times 768 pixels on a white background, with a fixed orthographic camera, lighting, and materials. The front view uses the viewer’s camera, and the right and left views rotate it by 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} in opposite directions about the vertical axis. Frames are neither interpolated nor dropped, so each method keeps its native frame count and rate. For the prompt-adherence judge described next, the three clips are concatenated in this order, with the view name written in the top-left corner of each frame.
blocks.zh: 所有动画都从正面,右面,左面的视图中渲染出相同的Tree.js取景器,在白色背景上为768×768/768\times768像素,带有固定的整形照相机,照明,以及材料. 前视图使用观众的相机,左右视图则在垂直轴的相反方向旋转90 ∘ 90^{\circ}. 帧既不是插值,也不是降值,因此每种方法都保持其原生帧数和速率. 对于接下来描述的即时遵守裁判,三段片段按此顺序排列,每个框的左上角写有视图名称.

blocks.en: The judge is GPT-6 Astra. We use it through its API call, not through its harness. From each view, we sample 16 evenly spaced frames, including the first and last, and send the resulting 48 frames to the judge as JPEG images resized to fit within 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels. Besides the frames, the judge receives only the asset’s short description, such as “Cartoon runner”. It is not shown the rest pose, it is not told which method produced the video, and it never sees the videos or scores of other methods. The evaluation is a conversation of two turns. In the first turn, the judge describes the motion in chronological order without seeing the action prompt. The second turn repeats the frames and this description, adds the action prompt, and asks for an integer score from 0 to 100 with a brief explanation. Both turns use low reasoning effort. fig. 6 illustrates the procedure, and section B.3 gives the complete prompts and responses for one example.
blocks.zh: 法官为GPT-6 Astra. 我们通过它的API呼吁使用它,而不是通过它的操纵. 从每个视图中,我们抽取16个均匀的间距帧,包括第一个和最后一个,并将由此产生的48个帧作为JPEG图像调整尺寸,以在512×512 512\时512像素内匹配,发送给评委. 除了框架外,法官只收到资产简短的描述,如 " 卡通跑者 " 。 它没有显示其他的姿势,也没有被告知录像是用哪一种方法制作的,它从不看到录像或其他方法的几十种。 评估是两个回合的对话. 在第一个回合,法官在未看到动作迅速的情况下按时间顺序描述动议。 第二个回合重复了帧和这个描述,增加了动作提示符,要求从0到100的整数分数,并附有一个简短的解释. 两者都使用低推理努力. 数字。 6 说明了程序,B.3节提供了完整的提示和答复。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Prompt-adherence evaluation of one animation with GPT-6 Astra. In the first turn, the judge is given the asset’s short description and 48 frames of the animation, 16 from each of the front, right, and left views, each frame labeled with its view; the figure shows two frames per view. It is asked to describe the motion it observes in chronological order. In the second turn, it scores the motion against the action prompt. The complete prompts and responses are given in section B.3 .

blocks.en: We use GPT-5.6 Sol to select 250 prompts from the official HumanML3D test split ( Guo et al., 2022 ) according to predefined criteria: a single person, motion observable in video, physical validity, and diversity. The benchmark contains 25 prompts from each of ten action families. EchoMotion is evaluated with its released text-to-video configuration and default inference settings. For our model, GPT-5.6 Sol converts each action caption into a short, appearance-only FLUX ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) prompt describing one person in a scene suited to the action. We apply HMR2 ( Goel et al., 2023 ) to the resulting image and convert its estimated SMPL body proportions and projected 2D joints into our rest-skeleton and reference-pose conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-5.6 Sol从官方HumanML3D测试拆分(Guo等人,2022年)中根据预先定义的标准选择250个提示:一个人,在视频中可观察到的运动,物理有效性,以及多样性. 该基准包含十个行动家庭的25个提示。 EchoMotion以其发布的文本到视频配置和默认推论设置来评价. 对于我们的模型,GPT-5.6 Sol将每个动作字幕转换成一个短的,只外观的FLUX(Black Forest Labs,2024年)迅速描述一个人在一个适合动作的场景中. 我们对产生的图像采用HMR2(Goel等人,2023年),并将其估计的SMPL体比例和预测的2D关节转换成我们的休眠-斯凯莱顿和参考物。

blocks.en: We fine-tune the general checkpoint for 10K steps on the human subset of our training data (App. A.6 ), with motion expressed on the SMPL skeleton used by EchoMotion.
blocks.zh: 我们根据我们训练数据的人的子集(App. A.6)对一般检查点进行微调,并在EchoMotion使用的SMPL骨架上表达动作。

blocks.en: For each generated video, we recover an SMPL trajectory with GVHMR ( Shen et al., 2024 ) and compare it with the trajectory generated alongside the video. PA-MPJPE is the mean per-joint position error after independently aligning each generated frame to the recovered trajectory with a rigid rotation and translation, adapted from Martinez et al. (2017) . SA-MPJPE subtracts the root position in every frame and fits a single rotation over the entire sequence, which removes global translation while preserving errors in orientation changes over time. SA-MPJVE is the mean error between adjacent-frame joint displacements under the SA-MPJPE alignment, reported in mm/s at each method’s native frame rate.
blocks.zh: 对于每个生成的视频,我们用GVHMR(Shen等人,2024年)回收SMPL轨迹,并将其与视频同时产生的轨迹进行比较. PA-MPJPE是在将每个生成的帧与回收的轨迹独立对齐后,根据Martinez等人(2017年)改编而成的刚性旋转和翻译的每联合位置平均误差. SA-MPJPE减去每个帧中的根位置,并适合整个序列的单一旋转,这可以去除全局翻译,同时保留方向变化中随时间推移的错误. SA-MPJVE是在SA-MPJPE对齐下相邻帧联移之间的平均误差,按每种方法的原生帧率以毫米/秒表示。
